Select: a2.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value
Source: activities a, assays a2, target_dictionary td, molecule_dictionary md, compound_structures cs
Join: a.assay_id = a2.assay_id AND a.molregno = md.molregno AND md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1250417' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a2.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.tid = a2.tid
Filter: a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a2.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1250417' AND td.tid = a2.tid
Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
Limit: 1000
